title: What Chiropractic Is All About
description: Chiropractors are doctors of chiropractic (DC) who diagnose and treat musculoskeletal disorders, especially of the spine, using hands-on adjustments, soft-tissue work, and rehabilitation. They focus on restoring joint motion and reducing pain without drugs or surgery. Patients include office workers with back and neck pain, athletes, pregnant patients, and seniors. Chiropractors work in private clinics, multidisciplinary practices, sports teams, and corporate wellness programs. This record lays the foundation: the core purpose, the people it serves, and where it fits in everyday life.

title: History and Evolution
description: Chiropractic began in 1895 when Daniel David Palmer performed the first adjustment in Davenport, Iowa. The profession fought decades of legal battles for legitimacy, winning licensure in all US states by the 1970s and growing into a mainstream musculoskeletal discipline. Knowing where the trade came from explains why things are done the way they are — and which 'rules' are just old habits.
key_points: History explains current practice.
Key point: Chiropractic began in 1895 when Daniel David Palmer performed the first adjustment in Davenport, Iowa.

Tradition plus testing beats either alone.
